platform: macOS aarch64 public Step0-Step6 black-box workflow
trigger: official Amazon Corretto 8u504 macOS aarch64 JDK archive whose valid full-JDK layout has java, javac, javap and rt.jar but no physical release file
actual_pre_fix_behavior: Step0 rejected the selected full JDK with JDK_RELEASE_MISSING before compiling or executing the probe
expected_behavior: a full JDK must be accepted when its own java executable supplies a parseable version and runtime properties; the exact executable bytes and complete probe output must be content-bound, and Step0-Step6 plus the independent Oracle must still pass
root_cause: JDK identity and version discovery treated the optional vendor release metadata file as a mandatory full-JDK capability
reproduction: Verify the archive bytes against the vendor-published SHA-256 and unpack it without adding synthetic metadata.
Select the unpacked Contents/Home as both base and current JDK for the public artifact workflow.
Run Step0-Step6 and require java-properties-probe as the metadata source on both sides.
Repeat with a release-less hard-linked mirror of the same JDK bytes and compare the complete closed truth.
